title: AXN as anti-suppression infrastructure: claims, falsifiers and precedents
description: AXN as Anti-Suppression Infrastructure states its properties as claims each with a falsifier: derivation integrity, record binding, ledger continuity, core integrity under amendment, custody, reconstructibility and the retrieval-layer hypotheses, and records which remain design rather than demonstrated property. Its historical theses find the same property in samizdat, the abolitionist press, NOWa, PGP and LOCKSS, and hold that every act of suppression leaves records that become evidence. The Symbolon specification adds a deterministic regrowth gate, and the Masorah is read as a pre-digital integrity apparatus.

claims.statement: Two features of samizdat matter beyond the replication itself. Copies were *verified against the remembered original* — readers who had seen earlier copies could confirm that new ones matched — an informal anticipation of content-derived integrity. And transmission was conditional on reading: each link in the chain had passed the text through their own hours and hands, which kept the network from carrying what no reader found worth a night of typing.
